移动鼠标或按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Backspace 接管: Move the mouse or press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Backspace to take over
需要 Windows 开发者模式；只有验证通过后才会开启。: Requires Windows Developer Mode; enabled only after verification succeeds.
请先在 Windows 设置中开启开发者模式，再重试。: Enable Developer Mode in Windows Settings first, then try again.
开启后，已配对 Maxa 可以使用本机文件、搜索和命令能力。不设置目录白名单。: When enabled, paired Maxa clients can use local files, search and commands. There is no directory allowlist.
操作当前用户的交互桌面。需要已登录并解锁；你随时可以接管或停止控制。: Controls the current user's interactive desktop. Sign in and unlock it first; you can take over or stop control at any time.
通过这台电脑连接 Android。开启模块不会自动授予手机调试或输入权限。: Connects Android devices through this computer. Enabling the module does not grant phone debugging or input permissions.
该操作正在进行: This operation is already in progress
开启所需能力，再把这台设备交给可信的 Maxa 客户端。: Enable the capabilities you need, then connect this device to a trusted Maxa client.
已配对客户端可使用开启的模块: Paired clients can use enabled modules
配对代表信任，不是目录沙箱。关闭模块或解除配对可持续禁止访问；停止按钮只取消当前: Pairing establishes trust, not a directory sandbox. Disable a module or unpair to block future access. Stop only cancels current operations; new requests may continue.
模块独立启停。依赖保存在 App 私有目录，不替换你的全局开发环境。: Modules start and stop independently. Dependencies stay in the App's private directory without replacing your global development environment.
文件与命令使用本机用户权限，不设目录授权。远程文件使用绝对路径；关闭模块会拒绝新: Files and commands use the local user's OS permissions, without directory grants. Remote files require absolute paths. Disabling the module rejects new calls and cancels its managed work.
只作用于当前活动用户桌面，不绕过锁屏或 UAC。没有控制租期；停止当前操作后，新: Only controls the active user's desktop, without bypassing the lock screen or UAC. There is no control lease; new requests can continue after stopping the current operation.
添加后，新请求自动尝试连接并准备控制，无需手动恢复。关闭模块或移除设备可持续禁用: Once added, new requests automatically try to connect and prepare control, without manual resume. Disable the module or remove the device to block access. Phone OS permissions still apply.
从 Maxa 发起申请，在这里批准。配对长期有效，你随时可以撤销。: Request access from Maxa and approve it here. Pairing remains valid until you revoke it.
在 MaxaConfig 的设备页选择局域网设备，或输入这台电脑的可达 IP:P: Select a LAN device in MaxaConfig, or enter this computer's reachable IP:Port. Compare the verification codes on both sides before approving a request.
。监听地址不一定能从其他机器访问；跨网段需要可达地址，不提供自动穿透。: . The listen address may not be reachable from other computers. Cross-network access requires a reachable address; automatic traversal is not provided.
批准的是可信客户端，不是单个目录。它可使用当前及以后开启的模块；关闭模块、移除手: You approve a trusted client, not an individual directory. It can use modules enabled now or later. Disable a module, remove a phone or unpair to block future access. Stop only cancels current operations.
可使用 App 已开启的模块 · 无控制租期: Can use enabled modules · No control lease
请从 Maxa 的设备页发起控制申请。: Request control from the Devices page in Maxa.
开启 Android 模块后，通过 USB 授权或无线配对添加设备。: Enable the Android module, then add a device through USB authorization or wireless pairing.
这些记录仅用于阻止自动重新添加，不表示设备仍可访问。: These records only prevent automatic re-adding. They do not mean the devices remain accessible.
已移除 · 不会自动恢复: Removed · Will not be restored automatically
新请求自动尝试恢复连接，无需续租或手动恢复控制。移除的设备不会自动加回；手机调试: New requests automatically try to reconnect, without lease renewal or manual resume. Removed devices are not re-added automatically. Debugging authorization and pairing codes remain local human actions.
断开连接不代表命令已经停止。以远端任务的实际状态为准。: Disconnecting does not mean a command has stopped. Refer to the actual remote job state.
配对保持有效；实际操作进行时在这里显示其归属。: Pairing remains valid. Active operations and their owners appear here.
不展示命令正文或凭据: Command contents and credentials are hidden
这里显示受管命令，不把应用启动确认当成业务完成。: Managed commands appear here. Confirming an application launch does not mean its work has completed.
请刷新状态后重试。: Refresh the status and try again.
更改自动保存到本机，下次启动继续使用。: Changes are saved locally and retained on the next launch.
随 Windows 登录启动: Launch when signing in to Windows
仅为当前用户设置，不需要管理员权限。: Applies to the current user only. No administrator privileges required.
启动时最小化到系统托盘: Start minimized to the system tray
后台恢复模块；通过右下角托盘打开窗口。: Restore modules in the background. Open the window from the system tray.
不支持的系统语言使用英文。: Unsupported system languages fall back to English.
请从 Maxa Device 原生应用打开。连接错误不会显示成可用状态。: Open this interface from the native Maxa Device App. Connection failures are not shown as ready.
请与发起请求的 Maxa 设备页逐字核对。名称相同不代表身份相同；不一致时拒绝。: Compare the code exactly with the requesting Maxa Devices page. Matching names do not establish identity. Reject any mismatch.
批准后，该客户端可长期使用 App 当前和以后开启的所有模块，包括相应文件、命令: Once approved, this client can persistently use all modules enabled now or later, including their files, commands, desktop and phone operations. There is no directory sandbox or per-operation permission list. Disable a module, remove a phone or unpair to block future access. Stop only cancels current operations.
已批准控制申请，配对长期有效，直到你主动解除: Control approved. Pairing remains valid until you unpair.
已请求停止这台手机当前操作；新请求可继续。持续禁用请移除设备或关闭模块。: Requested cancellation of this phone's current operations. New requests may continue. Remove the device or disable the module to block access.
立即停止这台手机的控制并禁止后续访问。刷新、重连不会自动恢复；需要你明确重新添加: Immediately stop control of this phone and block future access. Refreshing or reconnecting will not restore it; you must explicitly add it again. Other phones and phone data are not affected.
设备已移除，自动发现不会重新开放控制: Device removed. Automatic discovery will not restore control.
重新核对这台手机的当前连接通道。添加后，已配对客户端可通过开启的 Android: Verify this phone's current transport again. Once added, paired clients can use it through the enabled Android module. Phone OS debugging permissions still apply.
已重新添加，请以设备实际连接状态为准: Device added again. Check its actual connection state.
在手机“无线调试 → 使用配对码配对设备”中取得以下信息。配对码不会写入日志或发: Get these details from Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code on your phone. The code is not logged or sent to the Agent.
配对已完成；如设备未自动出现，请连接无线调试主页显示的地址: Pairing completed. If the device does not appear, connect using the address on the main Wireless debugging screen.
填写手机“无线调试”主页上的地址和端口，不是配对码窗口的端口。重启或重新开启调试: Enter the address and port from the main Wireless debugging screen, not the pairing code window. The port may change after a restart or after toggling debugging.
连接请求已完成，请确认设备的实际可用状态: Connection request completed. Check the device's actual availability.
已提交当前操作的停止请求；新请求仍可继续，持续禁用请关闭模块或解除配对。: Stop requested for current operations. New requests may continue. Disable a module or unpair to block future access.
App 将检查并按需安装固定版本私有依赖，不修改全局环境。开启后，所有已配对客户: The App will verify and install pinned private dependencies as needed, without changing the global environment. All paired clients can then use this capability without per-operation grants. Removed phones are not re-added.
将拒绝新调用并取消此模块的受管工作。已经发生的操作不会回滚。: New calls will be rejected and this module's managed work will be cancelled. Effects that have already occurred are not rolled back.
立即拒绝该客户端的新调用，释放其控制权并取消受管工作。已发生的副作用不会回滚，重: Immediately reject this client's new calls, release its control and cancel its managed work. Existing effects are not rolled back. Connecting again requires new pairing.
将停止受管模块、设备控制和受管进程。已成功移交的独立应用不会被自动关闭。若只想隐: Managed modules, device control and managed processes will stop. Successfully detached applications will not be closed automatically. To hide the window without stopping service, close it to the tray.
